Broomfield County CO was created 2001-11-15 from parts of Adams 08001 (15,870 people), Boulder 08013 (21,512), Jefferson 08059 (1,726) and Weld 08123 (69). Merging all five would destroy four major Front Range counties carrying $7.1bn of contracts in order to absorb $0.14m. Broomfield is assigned to Boulder alone, its plurality parent at 55% of the transferred population. THIS IS THE ONLY GROUP IN THE FILE THAT IS NOT A UNION OF WHOLE 1990-vintage counties, and the only place the crosswalk knowingly puts money in a unit that did not contain it. Run with --broomfield-merge-all for the four-parent alternative.
